candidate_sensitivity_only_if_inputs_rec.near_signal: No bullish transition and absolute(close-SAR)/close <= 0.02; report separately, never optimize tolerance.

appendix.source: Coin Metrics PriceUSD daily plus FRED SP500 daily close, latest accessible vintages; not a point-in-time database.
appendix.btc_price_label: PriceUSD row dated d is end of UTC day d, equivalent to d+1 00:00 UTC.
appendix.sp_classification: Sign of current S&P close / previous available trading-session close minus one; flat sessions excluded.
appendix.execution_timing: Enter at 00:00 UTC after the S&P session; no BTC return before that instant is predictive outcome.
appendix.sp_availability_limit: Underlying index close is assumed known by entry; FRED publication vintages are unavailable. This tests lagged market information, not executable latency through FRED.
appendix.primary_estimand: Mean forward BTC log return after green minus after red S&P sessions.
appendix.secondary_horizon_multiplicity: Holm correction over all five horizons.
appendix.null_test: 1999 circular shifts of sign labels, offsets >=21 and <=n-21; two-sided difference statistic; exploratory stationarity limitation.
appendix.btc_trend_conditioning: Entry price greater than trailing 200-calendar-day simple moving average; all prices known at entry.
appendix.descriptive_only: Same UTC-day BTC returns conditioned on that day's later S&P close; never tradable evidence.
appendix.strategy_diagnostic: One calendar-day BTC exposure following a green S&P session, cash otherwise; consecutive active days have no extra turnover.
